newsitem.title: FRANCE: Aerospatiale seen taking over Dassault in tax play.
newsitem.headline: Aerospatiale seen taking over Dassault in tax play.

text.p: State-owned aircraft company Aerospatiale is expected to take over Dassault Aviation in a forthcoming merger, for tax reasons, newspaper La Tribune reported on Tuesday.

The report, citing sources close to the defence and finance ministries, said the decision for a takeover by Aerospatiale of Dassault and not vice versa was driven by tax considerations, particularly tax losses held by Aerospatiale.
Dassault Industries, the holding company for Dassault Aviation, could hold 20 percent of the merged company, the report said.
